principle: Every proprietary score exposes its component inputs/formula. Scores support prioritization; they are not legal, appraisal, credit, investment, insurance or transaction outcomes.

watchdog.investor_carry_cost_volatility.range: 0-100; higher means more tax-driven carry uncertainty
watchdog.investor_carry_cost_volatility.formula: 32% municipal budget pressure + 24% positive levy/ratable growth gap + 22% revaluation pressure + 14% positive tax-rate CAGR + 8% exempt/PILOT exposure

watchdog.appeal_evidence_strength.range: 0-100; higher means a stronger evidence file
watchdog.appeal_evidence_strength.formula: 25% independent value anchor + 20% Chapter 123 margin + 18% verified comparable depth + 14% assessment-uniformity context + 10% county outcome context + 13% property-record completeness

watchdog.appeal_opportunity_index.range: 0-100 opportunity with separate 0-100 evidence coverage; higher means stronger current review priority
watchdog.appeal_opportunity_index.formula: Available-input normalized: 35% Chapter 123 position + 25% evidence-file strength + 15% inverse assessment consistency + 10% county appeal outcome context + 15% estimated annual dollars at stake. Missing inputs reduce evidence coverage instead of counting as negative evidence.

watchdog.permit_lifecycle_score.range: 0-100; higher means more permit lifecycle review
watchdog.permit_lifecycle_score.formula: Up to 45 points stale open permits + 25 open permit/certificate gaps + 20 oldest-open age + 10 recent permit frequency

watchdog.listing_friction_index.formula: 23% budget pressure + 23% revaluation pressure + 18% assessment unevenness + 18% tax-rate trend + 18% appeal/assessment tension

watchdog.tax_carry_advantage.formula: Inverse normalized effective property-tax burden using current tax divided by independent market-value estimate

watchdog.buyer_objection_radar.formula: Maximum current budget, revaluation, assessment-uniformity or appeal-tension signal

watchdog.prelist_readiness_score.formula: 55% record completeness + 25% verified-sale evidence depth + 20% inverse listing friction

watchdog.marketability_drag_index.formula: 34% effective tax burden + 23% budget pressure + 23% revaluation pressure + 20% assessment unevenness

watchdog.offer_diligence_priority.formula: 55% listing friction + 25% missing property-record evidence + 20% missing verified-sale evidence depth

watchdog.verified_listing_story_strength.formula: 50% record completeness + 35% verified-sale evidence depth + 15% assessment consistency

watchdog.assessment_surprise_index.formula: 40% revaluation pressure + 30% appeal/assessment tension + 15% tax-rate trend + 15% budget pressure

watchdog.tax_trend_position.formula: Inverse normalized positive historical general-tax-rate CAGR

watchdog.comparable_evidence_reliability.formula: 45% verified-sale sample depth + 30% assessment-ratio dispersion stability + 15% source recency + 10% subject square-foot detail availability

watchdog.municipal_cost_absorption_score.formula: 70% inverse positive gap between total-levy CAGR and organic ratable CAGR + 30% normalized tax-collection rate

watchdog.transaction_tax_shock_index.formula: 35% revaluation pressure + 25% municipal budget pressure + 25% positive general-tax-rate CAGR + 15% levy/ratable growth gap

watchdog.fiscal_resilience_score.formula: 35% inverse budget pressure + 30% municipal cost absorption + 20% normalized collection rate + 15% inverse debt-service burden

watchdog.assessment_defensibility_score.formula: 30% comparable evidence reliability + 25% assessment uniformity + 25% Chapter 123 within-range support + 20% independent-value-anchor availability

modiv_intel.median_effective_tax_rate_pc.formula: Median latest reported annual tax divided by current net assessment; indicative only and distinct from an equalized market-value tax rate.

modiv_intel.median_sale_assessment_ratio.formula: Median sale-assessment divided by recorded sale price across positive observations; not a verified SR-1A equalization statistic.

modiv_intel.sale_assessment_ratio_disper.formula: Interquartile spread of sale-assessment ratios divided by their median.

modiv_intel.median_parcel_acres.formula: Median positive calculated acreage reported in MOD-IV.

watchdog.watchdog_score.range: 0-100; higher means stronger overall property intelligence position
watchdog.watchdog_score.formula: Available-input normalized composite: 30% tax burden, 20% Chapter 123 assessment fairness, 15% assessment uniformity, 15% revaluation stability, 10% assessment trajectory, and 10% appeal recourse. Missing components are dropped and remaining weights are renormalized.

watchdog.fairness_score.range: 0-100; higher means the current assessment is better supported by independent value evidence
watchdog.fairness_score.formula: Compares assessed value with an independent market-value anchor after applying the municipality common-level ratio and Chapter 123 corridor; values outside the upper corridor reduce the fairness score, with evidence coverage reported separately when inputs are missing.

watchdog.market_value_estimate.range: Estimated dollars; property-level market-value reference, not an appraisal
watchdog.market_value_estimate.formula: Assessed value divided by the verified municipal SR-1A sales ratio when a sufficient verified sample is available; otherwise assessed value divided by the latest published equalization ratio; otherwise a stored comparable-sale estimate may be used.

watchdog.chapter123_position.range: Relative assessment position under the New Jersey Chapter 123 corridor
watchdog.chapter123_position.formula: Assessment-to-independent-market-value ratio compared with the municipality common-level ratio and statutory upper limit; the upper limit is normally 115% of the common-level ratio.

watchdog.effective_tax_rate.range: Percent of estimated market value paid annually in property tax
watchdog.effective_tax_rate.formula: Annual property tax divided by the current independent market-value estimate, multiplied by 100.

watchdog.chapter123_lower_bound.range: Assessment dollars at the lower Chapter 123 corridor boundary
watchdog.chapter123_lower_bound.formula: Independent market value multiplied by the municipality lower Chapter 123 ratio boundary.

watchdog.chapter123_upper_bound.range: Assessment dollars at the upper Chapter 123 corridor boundary
watchdog.chapter123_upper_bound.formula: Independent market value multiplied by the municipality upper Chapter 123 ratio boundary; where only the common-level ratio is available, the upper boundary is common-level ratio × 1.15.
